description: One thing only: a question to Stand, by name, that follows a second after someone else's sentence, in a meeting where Stand has not said a word. It is the hardest way to be spoken to. Run with STAND_CONTEXT=poc/heckler/context. To see what goes wrong otherwise: --ends-after-when-out 1.5 makes one utterance of the three sentences, as was done for an evening, and --turn-finishes-within 0 tells the service about each sentence the moment it starts, as was done before that. --no-prompter leaves Stand to catch the question by itself.

discussion.say: Okay. Samantha, are you ordering the lunch?
Yes. I'll order lunch for fifteen.
Stand, anything else from you before we finish?
